answers.note: The PDF is the Europe PMC author manuscript of Stewart et al., Science 365:1461 (2019), 19 pages of real body text, and it is the only rendition: the manifest has no fulltext_xml. No methods or results heading was found because a Science research article carries none - the only headings are Abstract, Supplementary Material, Acknowledgments and References, with the Materials and Methods in the supplementary PDF.
Row 1 is the file's own caption ('Supplementary Data File 1. Table of barcodes...'), already lifted into the card caption; row 2 holds the column names, with an unnamed leading index column.

The unlabelled span runs from just after the Abstract to the Supplementary Material heading and is overwhelmingly results (pages 3-7); it also contains two introduction paragraphs on page 2 and one closing discussion paragraph on page 7, which a single section value cannot express.
The SM PDF's own title page names it 'Supplementary Materials for ...' and lists its contents (Materials and Methods, Figs. S1-S20, Tables S1-S10, captions, References).

sign_off.note: Fit to curate from with three caveats. First, 52 of 87 main-text blocks are still unlabelled: the body is a Europe PMC author manuscript of a Science article, which carries no Results or Methods headings, and the section_span answer recording that span as results does not apply because Overrides.section_for has no callers. Second, the two largest supplements are truncated at the 5000-row scan cap - Data File S1 keeps 4998 of 40270 rows and Data File S2 keeps 4998 of 27205 - so per-cell barcode annotations drawn from them are partial. Third, the supplement_set_unverified caveat is satisfied in substance: the SM PDF lists Materials and Methods, Figs. S1-S20, Tables S1-S10 and Data Files S1-S10, which is exactly the eleven files held.
